summary: Draped, laced and rolled truck tilts; bulging bags, rucksacks and strapped bedrolls; their own finishes for webbing, nylon, vinyl and rope; seats in cockpits and cabs; helicopter doors open on troop seats; recognition panels and covers; plastic trim, worn paint and soft glints on cars.
rationale: Cloth, kit, glass-side interiors and finishes across many families: one matched studio sheet shows a representative of each, framed close where the change is small.
